# Task P5-05: Frontend — System → Tasks, Backup and Logs

**Phase:** 5 · **Depends on:** P5-03 (backup API), P5-04 (tasks run times, log API) — both merged on the base branch before this runs · **Suggested tier:** T2 standard worker · **Estimated size:** M

## Goal

The *arr "System" section gains what operators expect: the Tasks page shows each scheduled task's interval, last and next run, last duration and result with a working "Run now", plus the recent command history; a Backup page lists backups and can back up now, download, restore (with a confirmation) and delete; a Logs page shows the app's own log entries with a level filter, a text filter and paging, and offers the log files for download.

## Deliverables

- `frontend/src/api/schema.d.ts` — regenerate from `docs/api/openapi.json` first (`npm run` script — check `frontend/package.json` for the `openapi-typescript` script name) so the new endpoints are typed. Do not hand-edit it.
- `frontend/src/api/system.ts` (new; the TanStack Query hooks for this task, in the style of `frontend/src/api/plex.ts`/`compact.ts`): `useBackups`, `useCreateBackup`, `useDeleteBackup`, `useRestoreBackup(id)`, `useUploadRestore(file)`, `useLogs({ page, pageSize, level, filter })`, `useLogFiles`, `useCommands()` (the recent command history: `GET /api/v1/command` — check what it returns), plus a helper building the download URLs (`/api/v1/system/backup/{id}/download`, `/api/v1/log/file/{name}`) **through the app's URL base** (see how `client.ts` builds URLs) — downloads must work behind a URL base and with the session cookie (plain `<a href download>` is fine when the cookie authenticates; check `client.ts` for how the API key/cookie is sent).
- `frontend/src/pages/system/TasksPage.tsx`:
  - **Bug fix:** "Run now" sends `{ name: task.name }`, but `name` is the display name (`"Missing Search"`); the command name is `task.taskName` (`"MissingSearch"`). Send `taskName`. Add a test that would have caught it.
  - Columns: Task, Interval (human: `1 min`, `15 min`, `6 h`, `1 day`, `7 days`), Last run, Last duration (`lastDuration`, `hh:mm:ss` as the API sends it; `—` for `00:00:00` when the task never ran), Next run, Last result, Run now.
  - A "Recent commands" table under it (name, status, queued/started/ended, duration, message) from `useCommands`, newest first, at most 20; refetch every 5 s while any is queued or running (and when the SignalR command event arrives, if the app already invalidates on it — check `frontend/src/app/signalr.ts`).
- `frontend/src/pages/system/BackupPage.tsx` (route `system/backup`): the list (name, type, size human-readable, time), "Back up now" (spinner, then the list refreshes), per row Download, Restore, Delete; "Restore from file…" (a file input accepting `.zip`). Restore and Delete ask for confirmation in a Mantine modal; the restore modal says the app restarts and **the API key and every setting become the backup's**. After a successful restore request, show a full-width notice "Restoring — Wondarr is restarting" and poll `GET /ping` every 2 s until it answers again, then reload the page. A 400 from restore shows its reason.
- `frontend/src/pages/system/LogsPage.tsx` (route `system/logs`): a table (time, level badge coloured by level, logger, message; the exception expandable under the row), a level select (Information default, Debug, Warning, Error), a debounced text filter, paging (50 per page), a "truncated" notice when the API says so, and a "Log files" section listing the files with download links.
- Routes in `frontend/src/app/App.tsx` and the System entries in the navigation (find where `system/tasks` is linked in the shell) for Backup and Logs.
- Every page has a loading, an empty and an error state (`components/DataState`).
- Tests (Vitest + Testing Library, the existing page-test style with the fetch mock — copy `TasksPage.test.tsx`'s setup; Mantine renders with `env="test"` as the existing tests do):
  - `TasksPage.test.tsx` — run now posts `taskName`; durations and intervals render; the commands table renders.
  - `BackupPage.test.tsx` — list, back up now, delete with confirmation, restore with confirmation posts to the right URL, a 400 reason is shown.
  - `LogsPage.test.tsx` — rows, the level filter changes the request, paging, the files list links.
- `docs/architecture/ARCHITECTURE.md` — nothing unless a route list for the UI exists there (check; update it if so).
